newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Linkful 1996 net loss HK$180.69 mln.
newsitem.headline: Linkful 1996 net loss HK$180.69 mln.

text.p: Company name Linkful International Holdings Ltd
NOTE - Linkful International is a steel trader.

Net is after an exceptional loss of HK$98.56 million on doubtful debt provision against trade receivables, loss of HK$23.56 million on provision for permanent diminution in value of investment in and amount due from an unconsolidated subsidiary, loss of HK$10.01 million on provision for permanent diminution in value of a long-term investment, loss of HK$0.55 million on disposal of an unconsolidated subsidiary, loss of HK$4.17 million on disposal of fixed assets, loss of HK$8.15 million on provision for permanent diminution in value of fixed assets and gain of HK$2.94 million on reversal of doubtful debt provision against trade receivables.
Total dividend for year is nil vs nil.
